annotation.title_clean: Responsible Innovation: Israel's Policy on Artificial Intelligence Regulation and Ethics
annotation.title_en: Responsible Innovation: Israel's Policy on Artificial Intelligence Regulation and Ethics
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Innovation, Science and Technology (Israel)
annotation.summary_en: English summary of Israel's December 2023 Ministry of Innovation, Science and Technology policy on AI regulation and ethics for the private sector. It favours soft, sector-specific regulation, consistent with OECD principles, and addresses seven challenges: discrimination, oversight, explainability, disclosure, safety, accountability and privacy.
key_provisions_or_claims: Empower sector-specific regulators to assess and regulate AI using soft, incremental tools
Responsible innovation concept balances innovation with accountability and ethics
Seven challenges: discrimination, human oversight, explainability, AI disclosure, safety, accountability, privacy
Establish an inter-agency forum and a multistakeholder forum for coordination
Develop a government AI risk management framework and engage in international standard-setting
